title: Fuller hair waves and a more natural upper-body pose
notes: Wider S-waves, repaired fringe contact, recessed nostrils, fuller lips, and a turned shirt pose move the bust closer to the reference. Remaining: excessive lower-lid volume, geometric collar leaves, and overly sharp hair tips. The result is still stylized, not a photoreal likeness.
review_method: Manual visual review of actual Eevee render; subjective, not measured likeness.
